align drop std::alignment_of -- boost::alignment::detail::alignment_of is `using std::alignment_of` only on some compilers; other targets (clang outside x86_64) define a template of that name, which the std re-export would conflict with.
asio extra boost::asio::socket_errc -- Like boost::asio::stream_errc: boost/asio/error.hpp simulates the proposed socket_errc scoped enum with a namespace of using-declarations of error:: enumerators, re-created here.
asio extra boost::asio::stream_errc -- boost/asio/error.hpp simulates the proposed stream_errc / socket_errc scoped enums with namespaces that hold only using-declarations of error:: enumerators (the cpp14 blocking_tcp_echo_server example compares with boost::asio::stream_errc::eof). The generator collects declared entities, not using-declarations, so those namespaces are re-created here.

leaf extra boost::leaf::detail -- M9: gcc 16.1.0 module consumers emit a partial vtable for exception<bad_result> (multi-base exception_base/error_id) whose non-virtual thunks stay undefined — gcc never emits them in a module consumer TU. This extern template suppresses the consumer's implicit instantiation; the complete vtable + thunks come from the explicit instantiation in port/leaf_extras.cpp (same pattern as thread's clone_impl, cf. M7c).

thread extra boost -- M7c: gcc 16.1.0 module consumers emit a partial vtable for clone_impl<T> (virtual base clone_base) whose thunk slots stay undefined — gcc never emits the thunks in a module consumer TU. These extern-template declarations suppress the consumer's implicit instantiation; the complete vtable + thunks come from the explicit instantiation in port/thread_extras.cpp (same pattern as boost_system_extras.cpp).
